definitions.full: H3150. Yizziyyah יִזִּיָּה proper name, masculine ( may ׳י sprinkle , read probably ᵐ5 ׳יַזּ, Αζεια , N Αδεια , ᵐ5 L Ιαζιας ); — one of those who took strange wives Ezra 10:25 .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as the first part of 3149 and 3050 ; sprinkled of Jah ;
